item.title: Yann LeCun Challenges Dario Amodei on Safety Pacing in Pointed Public Exchange
item.summary: Yann LeCun amplified a pointed four-part challenge to Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei on X, questioning whether safety-driven deployment pacing costs lives, whether guardrails block legitimate cybersecurity use, whether data retention policies constitute a double standard, and whether evaluation-aware models can be reliably tested.
